title: Use existing targeted tail repair for stale-session watchdog recovery
outcome: Implement approved Option T from Fable627: stale-session-only watchdog recovery uses the existing per-session tail repair for every stale id, retaining the15s cooldown; drift/gap/shared-snapshot/late-join paths retain full recovery. This optional companion is a separate producer input so the parent’s already accepted test-only handoff and Merger claim remain untouched.
acceptance: For stale-session-only watchdog ticks, repair every stale local non-detached session through existing startSessionHydration(id, {forceTailRepair: true, queueAfterCurrent: true}) when the existing lastFullStateServerInstanceIdRef equals the non-null lastSeenServerInstanceId and reconnect recovery is confirmed; retain the existing 15s attempt cooldown and first-reply/stalled/never-hydrated hidden-session recovery.

Keep full recovery for drift (including drift plus stale), gap, sharedSnapshotRequired, late join, unknown or unmatched full-state instance, unconfirmed reconnect, and remote or detached stale sessions; retain the tail owner’s existing adoption/fallback/coalescing behavior. Production changes only in ui/src/app-live-state-transport.ts, one thin existing-ref caller change in ui/src/app-live-state.ts, and the docs/architecture.md paragraph; no new endpoint, timer, poller, cache, ledger or revision change.

Run one combined focused UI check covering the changed stale-session schedules and existing full-recovery/tail boundaries, run tsc, obtain the standard independent Codex/Claude review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium+, and send one complete exact-input READY to the integration owner.
